entries.title: School brought us together
entries.description: We started as classmates and slowly became the friends who could always count on each other.

entries.title: The shared-ride days
entries.description: Every ride gave us another chance to talk about school, life, dreams, and absolutely everything else.

entries.title: The endless conversations
entries.description: We could start with one small topic and somehow talk for hours without running out of things to say.

entries.title: The fun and games
entries.description: Playing together, joking around, and making each other laugh gave us memories I will always keep.

entries.title: Your loyal heart

entries.title: Your kindness

entries.title: The times you guided me
entries.description: Your advice helped me through many moments. You never made me feel alone when I needed direction.

entries.title: Still close after all these years

reasons.title: The Friend I Can Always Trust
reasons.intro: After all our school days and every chapter since then, I know exactly why your friendship means so much to me, bro.

items.title: You are loyal
items.description: You stayed beside me through different seasons of life. Your loyalty is something I will never take for granted.

items.title: You are kind
items.description: Your kindness shows in the way you listen, help, encourage, and make people feel valued.

items.title: You guide me
items.description: Many times when I was confused or struggling, you gave me honest advice and helped me move forward.

items.title: You make life lighter

gift.title: Open My Birthday Letter
gift.intro: A small letter for my bro, the friend who has been close to my heart since school.
gift.letterText:
Dear bro,

We started as friends at school, sharing rides, talking about everything, playing together, and slowly becoming closer than I ever expected. From those school days until now, this friendship has become one of the greatest gifts in my life.

Thank you for always being loyal and kind. Thank you for guiding me many times when I did not know what to do, and for giving me the confidence to keep going. Your advice and support have meant more to me than I can explain.

Happy Birthday, bro. I hope this year brings you the same happiness and goodness you have given to the people around you. I am truly lucky to have you as my friend.

With gratitude,
Harish
